multiple_testing_accounting.methodology: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014) Deflated Sharpe Ratio + Bailey et al. (2016) Combinatorially Symmetric Cross-Validation (CSCV) PBO
multiple_testing_accounting.hurdle_description: Any candidate claiming statistical edge must survive penalization against K=32 trials and demonstrate positive out-of-sample expectancy.

reconciliation_audit.donchian_discrepancy_explanation: Earlier versions of generate_experiment_registry.py contained hardcoded static strings that misattributed unverified pre-repair numbers (-34.6 bps / -22.4% DD for Trend_Donchian_120h and -61.2 bps / -34.8% DD for Trend_Donchian_168h) and mislisted parameters as {'stop_loss': '2.0 * ATR', 'take_profit': 'None (Trailing)'}. The actual Phase 2.1 purged walk-forward engine (run_phase_2_1_research.py) uses {'stop_loss': '2.5 * ATR_14', 'take_profit': '4.0 * ATR_14', 'exit_type': 'fixed_atr'} and produced +1.01 bps pooled OOS expectancy (20.62% OOS MaxDD, 36.73 bps / -1.11% CAGR Holdout Fold 5) for Trend_Donchian_120h and +74.40 bps pooled OOS expectancy (24.06% OOS MaxDD, -8.11 bps / -2.99% CAGR Holdout Fold 5) for Trend_Donchian_168h, matching phase_2_1_candidate_comparison.md (+1.0 bps and +74.4 bps).

experiments.name: HybridModel (CNN-LSTM Classifier + Regressor)
experiments.hypothesis: A dual-head CNN-LSTM architecture operating on 15m candles and 4H macro features can predict 1-hour forward return direction and magnitude with positive edge.
experiments.reason_for_status: Severe overfitting to training window. In-sample directional accuracy ~56%, but out-of-sample directional accuracy degraded to 48.2% (below 50% random walk). Failed cost hurdle after 0.05% taker fees and slippage.

experiments.name: MajorityBaseline Benchmark
experiments.hypothesis: Predicting the historical majority class provides a non-trivial benchmark to verify pipeline trade logging and reconciliation.
experiments.reason_for_status: Reconciled baseline used to verify that pipeline executes and logs all trades without lookahead bias. Expectancy was negative (-42 bps) due to fee drag.

experiments.name: ARIMA-GARCH Volatility Regime Filter
experiments.hypothesis: GARCH(1,1) volatility forecasts can dynamically widen stops and reduce position size during volatility spikes, improving risk-adjusted return.
experiments.reason_for_status: Frequent convergence failures on short rolling windows; high computational latency on 15m live inference; did not produce positive net expectancy.

phases.title: High-Return Swing Trading & Regime-Aware Strategies
phases.data_scope: 32,720 1H candles resampled to 4H and 1D with synchronized 8H funding rates

experiments.name: Exp1_Momentum_Continuation_4H (Candidate A)
experiments.hypothesis: In an established 4H trend, a 3-bar counter-trend pullback followed by an engulfing volume breakout signals institutional continuation with favorable risk/reward.
experiments.reason_for_status: Produced positive Phase 2 expectancy (+53.08 bps, 52.27% win rate, 1.32 PF) and +135.3 bps pooled OOS expectancy in Phase 2.1. Low trade frequency (~12/yr) and failure of multi-trial DSR under K=32 prevented immediate live promotion.

experiments.name: Exp1_Donchian_55_Turtle_4H
experiments.hypothesis: Classic Richard Dennis 55-period breakout on 4H candles with ADX > 20 captures massive multi-week crypto trends.
experiments.reason_for_status: Excessive whipsaws in sideways regimes. Phase 2 win rate was 37.02% with -31.36 bps expectancy (Phase 2.1 OOS: +24.01 bps, MaxDD 12.25%).

experiments.name: Exp1_Pullback_Trend_4H
experiments.hypothesis: Entering pullbacks near 4H EMA20 when RSI is in a neutral-to-pullback zone (40-55 for Long) maximizes entry precision in strong trends.
experiments.reason_for_status: Premature stopouts on volatile ETH wicks. Phase 2 profit factor 0.74, expectancy -40.49 bps (Phase 2.1 OOS: -56.92 bps).

experiments.name: Exp1_SR_Breakout_Retest_4H
experiments.hypothesis: Waiting for a breakout of prior swing highs/lows with volume confirmation avoids false breakout traps.
experiments.reason_for_status: Breakouts frequently reversed in choppy conditions: Phase 2 expectancy -34.93 bps, Phase 2.1 OOS expectancy -21.55 bps.

experiments.name: Exp2_Gated_Trend_Regime3
experiments.hypothesis: Strictly restricting Donchian breakouts to verified Regime 3 (ADX > 25, high directional movement) filters out choppy losses.
experiments.reason_for_status: Lagging ADX indicator entered trends late near exhaustion points. Phase 2.1 OOS expectancy -60.19 bps (Phase 2 full-period: +-75.76 bps).

experiments.name: Exp2_Compression_Breakout_Regime1_to_2
experiments.hypothesis: Detecting volatility compression (narrow Bollinger Bands) followed by expansion predicts high-velocity trend initiation.
experiments.reason_for_status: High false breakout rate in ETH compression phases. Phase 2 expectancy 9.36 bps, Phase 2.1 OOS expectancy 14.69 bps.

experiments.name: Phase4_Combo_Regime_Selector
experiments.hypothesis: A master meta-selector combining Regime 3 trends and Regime 1 compression breakouts with 1D trend filtering achieves all-weather performance.
experiments.reason_for_status: Did not outperform individual components; high drawdowns in choppy transition months. Phase 2.1 OOS expectancy -9.54 bps (MaxDD 12.58%).

phases.title: Backtest Integrity Repair & Purged Walk-Forward Evaluation
phases.period: 2023-02-10 to 2026-11-04 (5 Chronological Folds: Folds 1-4 Walk-Forward OOS + Fold 5 Holdout)
phases.data_scope: 5 Chronological Folds with 168-hour purge windows and mandatory boundary position liquidation

experiments.name: Walk-Forward Candidate A (Exp1_Momentum_Continuation_4H)
experiments.hypothesis: Candidate A retains positive out-of-sample expectancy when evaluated independently across 4 chronological walk-forward folds and 1 untouched holdout fold with zero lookahead and 168h purge.
experiments.reason_for_status: CONFIRMED EDGE: Produced +135.3 bps pooled OOS expectancy (95% CI: [+35.2, +314.9] bps), 53.6% OOS win rate (56.8% across all 5 folds), OOS MaxDD 4.94%, and +103.9 bps on Holdout Fold 5.

experiments.name: Walk-Forward Trend_Donchian_120h
experiments.hypothesis: Extending Donchian 20 breakout holding horizon to 120 hours improves trend capture over 72h.
experiments.reason_for_status: Near-zero pooled OOS expectancy (+1.0 bps, 95% CI: [-143.8, +172.6] bps), excessive OOS max drawdown (20.62%, Fold 4 DD 13.65%), and negative Holdout Fold 5 CAGR (-1.11%, trade exp +36.7 bps).

experiments.name: Walk-Forward Trend_Donchian_168h
experiments.hypothesis: Allowing up to 168 hours holding horizon captures extended tail trends.
experiments.reason_for_status: Positive pooled OOS expectancy (+74.4 bps) fails statistical significance (95% CI: [-126.6, +296.4] bps), suffers severe OOS max drawdown (24.06% > 15% limit), and degrades to negative expectancy (-8.1 bps) on Holdout Fold 5.

phases.title: Statistical Audit & Candidate A Edge Attribution
phases.data_scope: Mathematical audit of quant_evaluation.py + Attribution analysis of 28 Walk-Forward OOS Candidate A trades (Folds 1-4, include_holdout=False)

experiments.name: Mathematical & Algorithmic Statistical Audit
experiments.hypothesis: DSR null benchmark scaling, CSCV Sharpe ranking, and bootstrap length preservation resolve all statistical measurement anomalies.
experiments.reason_for_status: All regression tests pass. DSR correctly distinguishes true skill from luck under K=32; CSCV ranks candidates via risk-adjusted Sharpe; bootstrap preserves exact N observations.

experiments.name: Candidate A Causal Edge Attribution
experiments.hypothesis: Decomposing Candidate A trades across market regimes, side, volume, and early path trajectory reveals the exact economic source of edge.
experiments.reason_for_status: On Walk-Forward OOS Folds 1-4 (28 trades, include_holdout=False), Short trades contributed 78.3% of profits ($1,007.30 of $1,286.76) and Regime 3 trends contributed 93.9% ($1,207.86, +239.7 bps expectancy, 2.75 PF). First-12-hour return strongly bifurcates OOS outcomes (76.47% win rate and 13.66 PF when positive at 12h vs 18.18% win rate and 0.28 PF when negative).
